advancedLaunch.dialogDescription: What runs when you press Play, and how LastSave recognizes this game while it runs.

trackingModeHints.auto: LastSave picks the best available signal for this game.
trackingModeHints.directory: Any process running inside the game's folder counts. Best for games with launchers or several executables.
trackingModeHints.exe: Only the exact executable path counts as this game.
trackingModeHints.processName: Matches by process name, wherever it runs from.
trackingModeHints.manualOnly: Never detected automatically. Sessions count only when you start and stop them yourself.
trackingModeHints.manualOnlyEmulator: The emulator is never detected automatically. Play still launches the game; the timer is fully yours.
